{{nihongo|'''Tatsushima Meoyanomikoto Shrine'''|建嶋女祖命神社}} is a {{ill|Shinto shrine|Q845945|qid=Q845945}} in {{ill|Chūdenchō|ja|中田町 (小松島市)|qid=Q11366737|lt=Nakata-chō}}, {{ill|Komatsushima, Tokushima|ar|كوماتسوشيما (توكوشيما)|azb|کوماتسوشیما، توکوشیما|ca|Komatsushima|ce|Комацусима|ceb|Komatsushimachō|de|Komatsushima|es|Komatsushima (Tokushima)|fa|کوماتسوشیما، توکوشیما|fi|Komatsushima|fr|Komatsushima|gl|Komatsushima|hy|Կոմացուսիմա|id|Komatsushima, Tokushima|it|Komatsushima|ja|小松島市|ko|고마쓰시마시|mg|Komatsushimachō|mzn|کوماتسوشیما، توکوشیما|nl|Komatsushima|pl|Komatsushima|pt|Komatsushima|ro|Komatsushima|ru|Комацусима|simple|Komatsushima, Tokushima|sv|Komatsushima|tg|Коматсушима|th|โคมัตสึชิมะ|tl|Komatsushima, Tokushima|tr|Komatsushima|tt|Комацусима|uk|Комацушіма|ur|کوماتسو شیما، ٹوکو شیما|vi|Komatsushima, Tokushima|war|Komatsushima, Tokushima|zh|小松島市|zh_classical|小松島市|zh_min_nan|Komatusima-chhī|zh_yue|小松島|qid=Q823493}}, {{ill|Tokushima Prefecture|Q160734|qid=Q160734}}. {{nihongo|'''Tatsushima Meoyanomikoto Shrine'''|建嶋女祖命神社}} is a [[shinto shrine]] in the [[Engishiki Jinmyōchō]]. It is located in [[Awa Province (Tokushima)]].

== Enshrined deities ==
With '''Tatsushima Meoyanomikoto''' (たつしまめおやのみこと) as principal deity, it also {{ill|Co-Enshrinement|ja|合祀|qid=Q11412524}} {{ill|Emperor Ōjin|Q317997|qid=Q317997}}.
[[File:Tatsushimajinjya distant view.JPG|thumb|Distant view of Tatsushima Shrine]]

Tatsushima Meoyanomikoto is often identified with Haniyasu-hime-no-Mikoto, though there are differing opinions. "Tatsushima" (or "Tate-shima") was also at times read "Takeshima," and in early modern gazetteers appears as "Takeshima Daimyōjin."

== Shrine crest ==
* Dakii-ne

It was also called Tatsushima Daimyōjin and Takeshima Daimyōjin. In Nakata-chō where this shrine stands, there are {{ill|Kofun cluster|ja|古墳群|qid=Q11411019}} from the early {{ill|Kofun period|Q459939|qid=Q459939}}, suggesting rule by local {{ill|Gōzoku|ar|غوزوكو|fa|گوزوکو|ff|Gōzoku|fr|Gōzoku|it|Gōzoku|ja|豪族|pt|Gōzoku|vi|Gōzoku|zh|豪族 (日本)|qid=Q84066}} since ancient times.
